The Gates of the Ashram: Grounding

The digital world isn't just a technological evolution; it's a metaphysical force of uprooting. By projecting your attention from link to link, from image to image, your consciousness undergoes permanent diffraction. The calculating intellect takes control, the superficial persona of your ego swells, and the connection to your true Self breaks. What modern society lazily calls "anxiety" or "burnout" is nothing but the cry of your soul suffocating under the weight of social masks.

An Ashram is not a place to escape to, it's a laboratory of Reality. Having crossed through two profound experiences of ego-dissolution, I gained the absolute certainty that time is a fiction and that separation is a total illusion.

The grounding I'm offering you here isn't a superficial wellness technique to "feel better." It's an act of spiritual sedition. It's the complete stopping of mental chatter to finally make room for the still Witness.

seven daily orientations

Step by step, back to your Center

Don't practice these to succeed or perform, but to let what's false in you die.

01

The retreat of silence

Watch your thoughts pass like clouds, realizing you are not the noise of the world, but the conscious space that holds it.

02

Facing your Shadow

Embrace the fatigue and frustrations accumulated in front of screens with a compassionate smile to dissolve the mirage.

03

Surrender to the Source

Move from the contraction of fear to the expansion of Grace by offering your doubts to the One.

04

The clarity of the mirror

Like the autistic children I work with every day, learn to read raw energy without cheating with appearances, to reclaim your native authenticity.

05

The immensity of the desert

Visualize the infinite horizon of the Sahara, where the mind has nowhere to hide, letting anguish evaporate into a vertical present.

your eternal home

Come lock in your energy leaks. Settle into your eternal home and realize you are whole, here and now.
